title: sericocalyx timorensis
intro: Sericocalyx timorensis, commonly known as the East Timorese Sericocalyx, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It is a shrub native to the island of Timor, known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include reducing fever, relieving pain, and treating infections, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. Further research is needed to fully understand the plant's potential health benefits and therapeutic applications.
